nodes.description: Array of wrapped genesis Kongz token ids held by the contract; used as the pool from which unwrapped ids are drawn.
Accumulated global score (totalSupply * time interval) used as denominator of the banana reward share.
Timestamp of the last global score synchronization.
Total amount of BANANA already realized by the contract through KONGZ.getReward().
Mapping of holder address to accrued score (balance * time interval).
Mapping of holder address to last score synchronization timestamp.
Mapping of holder address to the cumulative reward share already credited.
Constant IKongz NFT contract used for safeTransferFrom and getReward external calls.
Constant IBanana token contract used for getTotalClaimable, balanceOf and transfer external calls.
Constant end timestamp capping the score accrual window.
Internal pure helper returning the minimum of two values; caps timestamps at END.
Internal view function producing a pseudo-random seed from block.timestamp, block.difficulty and the sender.
External function that synchronizes scores, pulls rewards from KONGZ and transfers BANANA to msg.sender.
External function that locks genesis Kongz NFTs, records their ids and mints WGK at 100 tokens per Kongz.
External wrapper that forwards to unwrapFor for msg.sender.
Public function that burns WGK and pseudo-randomly returns genesis Kongz NFTs from genIds to a recipient.
Overridden ERC20 transfer that applies the syncScore modifier before moving tokens.
Overridden ERC20 transferFrom that applies the syncScore modifier before moving tokens.
External view computing the currently claimable BANANA amount for a holder.
ERC721 receiver hook invoked when a Kongz NFT is transferred to this contract.
Modifier that refreshes holder scores for a from/to pair using block.timestamp.
Modifier that refreshes the global score using block.timestamp and totalSupply.
Caller-controlled address used for score accrual, minting, burning and reward transfer.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for score intervals and pseudo-random seed generation.
External token transfer of the computed reward to msg.sender inside claimNanas.
External call into the Kongz NFT contract to realize BANANA rewards before computing globalClaimed.
External ERC721 safe transfer that can call back into onERC721Received on the recipient.
Unchecked multiplication _kongzIdsToWrap.length * 100 * 1e18 used as the mint amount in wrap.
Weak pseudo-randomness derived from block.timestamp and block.difficulty controlling which NFT is unwrapped.
Caller supplied array of Kongz token ids to wrap.
Number of genesis Kongz to unwrap in unwrapFor.
Address receiving the unwrapped Kongz NFTs.
Address whose claimable BANANA is being queried.
Seed input to _getSeed, carried over between loop iterations.
Sender address mixed into the pseudo-random seed.
Source address of the token movement synchronised by syncScore.
Destination address of the token movement synchronised by syncScore.
min(block.timestamp, END) value used inside the score modifiers.
Elapsed seconds since the last score update used to accrue score.
Amount of BANANA to transfer to the caller in claimNanas.
Computed share of the farming pool owed to the caller.
globalClaimed plus the currently claimable BANANA of the contract.
Index into genIds derived from the seed modulo the array length.
Genesis Kongz token id selected for unwrapping.
Projected global score used inside getClaimableNanas.
Projected holder score used inside getClaimableNanas.

edges.reason: msg.sender determines the caller's score, claimed amount and transfer recipient in claimNanas.
msg.sender is the owner from which Kongz are pulled and the mint recipient in wrap.
msg.sender is burned from and used as the seed source in unwrapFor.
block.timestamp determines the accrual interval inside the syncScore modifier.
block.timestamp determines the accrual interval inside the syncGlobalScore modifier.
block.timestamp feeds the weak entropy source used to select unwrapped NFT ids.
block.timestamp drives the projected intervals in getClaimableNanas.
User supplied Kongz id array controls the transfer loop and the minted amount.
_amount controls how many tokens are burned and how many NFTs are released.
_recipient is the destination of the unwrapped NFTs.
_holder selects the storage slots read for the claimable calculation.
_seed is consumed by _getSeed when non-zero.
_sender is hashed together with block values into the seed.
_from identifies whose holder score is refreshed in the modifier.
_to identifies whose holder score is refreshed in the modifier.
genIds supplies the token id selected and popped in unwrapFor.
globalScore is the divisor used to compute the caller share in claimNanas.
globalClaimed is added to the claimable amount to size the farmed pool.
holderScores[msg.sender] weights the caller share of the farmed pool.
holderClaimed[msg.sender] is subtracted to avoid double payment.
The KONGZ contract is the target of safeTransferFrom in wrap.
The BANANA contract provides claimable balances and receives the transfer call.
END caps the timestamp used for holder score accrual.
END caps the timestamp used for global score accrual.
globalScore seeds the projected global score in the view function.
holderScores[_holder] seeds the projected user score in the view function.
holderClaimed[_holder] is deducted from the projected share.
globalClaimed contributes to the projected farmed pool.
unwrap delegates execution to unwrapFor for msg.sender.
claimNanas is guarded by the syncScore modifier.
claimNanas is guarded by the syncGlobalScore modifier.
wrap is guarded by the syncScore modifier.
wrap is guarded by the syncGlobalScore modifier.
unwrapFor is guarded by the syncScore modifier.
unwrapFor is guarded by the syncGlobalScore modifier.
transfer runs under the syncScore modifier before ERC20.transfer.
transferFrom runs under the syncScore modifier before ERC20.transferFrom.
claimNanas performs an external BANANA transfer to the caller at the end.
claimNanas calls KONGZ.getReward when the contract balance is insufficient.
wrap calls KONGZ.safeTransferFrom for every Kongz id supplied.
unwrapFor calls KONGZ.safeTransferFrom inside the unwrap loop.
wrap computes the mint amount with unchecked multiplication of the array length.
_getSeed produces the entropy value later used to pick the unwrapped token.
BANANA.transfer hands control to an external token contract that can re-enter claimNanas before all accounting settles.
KONGZ.getReward is an untrusted external call executed before globalClaimed and the payout are finalized.
KONGZ.safeTransferFrom invokes the recipient hook, allowing re-entry into unwrapFor mid-loop.
KONGZ.safeTransferFrom invokes the recipient hook while wrap is iterating over user supplied ids.
safeTransferFrom triggers the ERC721 receiver hook implemented by onERC721Received.

normalization_plan.reason: _kongzIdsToWrap is only a wrap parameter and should be folded into the wrap function node.
_amount is only an unwrapFor parameter and should be folded into the unwrapFor function node.
_recipient is only an unwrapFor parameter and should be folded into the unwrapFor function node.
_holder is only a getClaimableNanas parameter and should be folded into that view function node.
_seed is only a _getSeed parameter and should be folded into the _getSeed function node.
_sender is only a _getSeed parameter and should be folded into the _getSeed function node.
_from is only a syncScore modifier parameter and should be folded into the modifier node.
_to is only a syncScore modifier parameter and should be folded into the modifier node.
time is a local computed from block.timestamp inside the score modifiers and belongs to the modifier node.
interval is a local accrual delta used by the score modifiers and belongs to the modifier node.
toSend is a claimNanas local whose value is transferred out and belongs to the unsafe transfer operation.
userShare is a claimNanas local feeding the payout and should be folded into the claimNanas node.
totalFarmed is a claimNanas local derived from getReward accounting and belongs to that external call context.
_index is an unwrapFor loop local selecting the array slot and should be folded into unwrapFor.
_tokenId is the unwrapFor local passed to safeTransferFrom and belongs to that unsafe operation.
_globalScore is a getClaimableNanas local and should be folded into the view function node.
userScore is a getClaimableNanas local and should be folded into the view function node.
